title: The Drowned Wolf
author: Mirabel Sandoval
blurb: Freya Sterling, a debt-bound temple scribe, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. But when the border wards fall on the same night the stars go out, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must steal back a soul sold to the court beneath the mountain before the last dragon-fire gutters out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
